Explain briefly why a metal spoon left in hot soup becomes warm at the handle. Aim for approximately 28–44 English tokens.

message.content: Heat transfers from the hot soup to the spoon through conduction. The metal’s free electrons rapidly carry thermal energy along the structure, warming the handle even though it does not directly touch the liquid, demonstrating efficient thermal conductivity in metals.
